name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: FRESH-GSMFIELDS-RETRY BUILD (v2): 0.5.0 was reported to still break reading after the auto-retry. Hypothesis: recreateComposeSecure()'s own checkRecipientCerts() call does a fresh certificate verification pass (asyncFindCertByEmailAddr, genuinely touching NSS) -- the same category of event (getCerts() alone, zero writes) that's been shown all session to disturb NSS's cert-resolution state for the rest of the session unless followed by a CertVerifier rebuild. cleanupAndReinit()'s reinit ran *before* this fresh disturbance, not after. Adds a second, unconditional reinitCertVerifier() call right after the cache rewarm, immediately before the retry send -- so the rebuild is always the last thing touching NSS before the send, regardless of what recreateComposeSecure() itself just did.
